sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure: a goal is treated as false when Prolog cannot prove it, not because its opposite has been proven.
sketches.resonance: Absence becomes a verdict made from silence rather than evidence.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroing weak references: a weak reference does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the object is deallocated.
sketches.resonance: What refuses to hold on is spared possession, but not loss.

sketches.mechanism: Linked processes propagate abnormal exits, so one process failing can take down the process bound to it.
sketches.resonance: A bond turns a private ending into a shared fate.
sketches.draft:
go() ->
    spawn_link(fun() -> exit(gone) end),
    receive
    after infinity -> ok
    end.
